description: This file defines the abstract class DelegatorFactory which provides methods to obtain Delegator instances, manage their concurrency, and configure delegated objects in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes static methods for retrieving Delegators by name, internally managing a cache of Futures, and a nested class for creating and initializing Delegator objects.

classes.name: DelegatorFactory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for obtaining Delegator instances, managing their lifecycle, and configuring them.

classes.name: DelegatorConfigurable
classes.description: Nested class implementing Callable to create and initialize Delegator objects asynchronously.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves a Delegator instance by name, blocking until the Future provides the result.

methods.name: getDelegatorFuture
methods.description: Provides a Future for a Delegator instance, creating and submitting a new one if necessary.
